svg.text: A263 (c): a non-ADJ wall whose gap holds a unit cell -- ROOM <= 1 is false as a bare-ring statement
non-ADJ floor at common tilt 2.000 deg, s = 3.8771: a = 0.03 (s1 does not reach the far slot: a + w = 1.064 < s - 2 = 1.877),
shift e = 1.060 >= 1 + w - sec = 1.034: a unit square (orange, flat) sits in the gap touching depth 0.02 --
exact SAT check passed; it does NOT contain O (O outside). This is what ROOM <= 1 must not claim on the non-ADJ family:
the free square has a free straight drop, so P1 (TOUCH-CELL) kills it -- a structure lemma, not room (open_pairs.md s.3.3).
Here b = 0.752 >= b_min = 0.707 and a >= a_min = 0.0175: the corner forms with the neighbours' offsets <= 1 admit
this wall (neighbour tilts 45 deg at the END corner, 2 deg at the START corner); the rest of the ring is not drawn.
